digest.component_or_area: CLI command structure / bridge noun group
propositions: The bridge noun must register as a working nested command group with preview and sync subcommands, without breaking any legacy top-level command or existing in-repo consumer
bridge preview must perform read-only operations and force the dry-run engine path, while bridge sync must mutate and force the live engine path
The Mode class, MODE_CAPS constant, and gated_mode reconcile-check compatibility value must survive intact through this change
The existing top-level rebar doctor store-repair command must remain functional and distinct from bridge fsck

No placeholder or unimplemented verb may be advertised; only preview and sync ship in this story; setup, check-access, fsck, status, pause, and resume land only with their functional implementations in dependent stories
Nested command dispatch must prevent sibling-owned verbs from falling through to top-level commands, and help/group/unknown-verb behavior must be explicit
